faq.title: Frequently asked pricing questions
faq.q1: How can I pay from Africa?
faq.a1: We accept Orange Money, Wave, MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money, and local bank transfers. You don't need a Visa card or an international bank account. Payment is made directly from your phone, as usual.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Basic and Advanced?
faq.a2: Basic credits power quick analyses: finding a supplier by image, summary report, contact messages. Advanced credits trigger a deep analysis with a full report (images, multi-source comparison, detailed profitability calculation, negotiation strategy, customs risk estimate).
faq.a3: Yes, fully. Orange Money, Wave, MTN MoMo, and Moov Money are all accepted. For PAYG packs, payment happens online on our secure platform. For subscriptions, you receive a mobile payment link on each monthly renewal.
faq.q4: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a4: Yes, at no cost. You can cancel your Standard or Pro subscription from your "Settings" area at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period — you keep your credits until the renewal date.
faq.a5: Credits from monthly subscriptions expire at the end of the billing month (no rollover). Credits purchased via PAYG (one-off packs) are valid for 12 months from the purchase date, with no rollover limit.

assistant.howDesc: BizKey WhatsApp Assistant connects your WhatsApp Business number to an automated agent: instant replies, a knowledge base, and handoff to a human whenever needed. Contact us to connect your number and configure your assistant — our team guides you through setup.
